notes.title: Bugfixes and Improvements - 5th August 2025
notes.notes: [p]Thank you all for suggestions and bug reports![/p][p][/p][h3]Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Units can now walk through buildings to prevent blocking yourself in via clumps of buildings that must be placed together (guilds, houses, graves)[/p][/*][*][p]If religion is enabled, religion icons will be displayed next to each Lord's name on the political map[/p][/*][*][p]If religion is enabled, hovering over faith policies will display whether you will gain or lose influence with other lords based on their religion[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list][*][p]Cavalry units can now move through gatehouses[/p][/*][*][p]Player can no longer swap catapult and cavalry onto walls by having ground unit attempt swapping from the gatehouse[/p][/*][*][p]Sawm now correctly displays that no food and drinks are consumed[/p][/*][*][p]Salah and Tahrim al-Khamr now grant Morale and Resolve at the turn they are acquired and not on the following turn[/p][/*][*][p]Grave no longer requires you to have religion selected, so playing with religion disabled still allows you to gain faith and happiness[/p][/*][*][p]Skirmish maps now correctly end if you survive a certain amount of turns[/p][/*][*][p]Smuggling criminal ability now correctly gives you mentioned amount of Spears and Bows[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing texture bug for certain buildings on mission 4[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some exploits in Mission 4[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some typos[/p][/*][/list]
